rationale: The agent canceled order #W3361211 without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The user’s stated goal was to change the luggage set in the order for a coat, then return the item if change wasn’t possible, and only cancel the entire order if there were issues. The agent proceeded directly to a full order cancellation with reason “no longer needed,” which does not reflect the user’s intent sequence and lacks evidence of attempting the change or item return. While the agent appears to have attempted authentication (lookup by name and ZIP) and viewed order details, the critical failure is executing a cancellation without explicit confirmation and not following the requested escalation path. Therefore, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
